annotations.title: Google Search Grounded Real-Time Fact & Citation Engine

description: Answers factual queries with live Google Search grounding, returning verified up-to-date answers accompanied by source URLs and grounding metadata. Use when verifying live web facts, documentation updates, or current events in a single low-latency call; for querying geographic places, coordinates, directions, and local business data via Google Maps grounding, use search_gemini_grounded_maps instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'prompt' ('recency_bias' defaults to 'past_24h'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (200 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

prompt.description: Factual question or search query to ground against live Google Search results.

recency_bias.description: Temporal preference for search snippets; defaults to 'any_time' when omitted.

name: search_gemini_grounded_web

citations.description: Structured Google Search grounding chunks and source URLs.

model.description: Gemini model used for grounded synthesis.
